title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache/parallelism
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Consolidates CI workflows into unified templates, reduces duplicated job definitions, improves cache keys and parallelism defaults. No runtime or API changes. Recommended for all repos to reduce CI maintenance burden.
description: Motivation: The repo has accumulated duplicated GH Actions workflows for lint/test/release across packages. This PR consolidates the common logic into reusable workflow templates and tunes cache keys and parallelism to reduce queue times and improve cache hit rates. Goals: 1) Reduce duplication and drift between lint/test/release pipelines; 2) Improve CI latency and caching across our monorepo; 3) Harden flaky integration jobs and add sensible defaults for parallelism; 4) Keep release automation behavior unchanged (dry-run tested). Changes include a migration to a central .github/workflows/ci-templates/ set, extraction of shared steps into an action composite, matrix size caps, improved cache keys that include package-lock hash and path-level fingerprints, and safer conditional logic for release jobs. Checklist: - [x] Extract shared steps into .github/actions/ci-helpers/composite.yml - [x] Add unified workflows: lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml using workflow_call - [x] Cap matrices to reasonable sizes and add dynamic splitting for large packages - [x] Implement stronger cache keys (node-modules fingerprint + package-lock hash + path fingerprint) - [x] Bump GitHub Actions used (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4) - [x] Fix flaky examples integration by adding retry wrapper and increasing timeouts - [x] Update docs/ci.md with migration notes Summary of risk: Low. All behavior preserved except CI structure changes. Release automation was validated in dry-run and a test tag. Follow-ups: track ENG-1248 to roll the templates out to smaller repos, and ENG-1252 to add metrics for cache-hit rate in the console.
commits: feat(ci): add workflow templates and composite actions; refactor(ci): migrate existing workflows to call templates; perf(ci): cap matrix size and improve cache keys; fix(ci): increase timeout and add retry for examples integration; chore(ci): bump actions versions and add docs update

testing_notes: Local CI dry-run via act and GitHub dry-run used. Verified cache key behavior by simulating package-level runs; observed cache hits increase from ~52% to ~78% in synthetic test; integration/examples retried up to 2 times before failing. Added logs around cache key composition for initial rollout.
